proposal.diagnosis: In update_score, win bonus calculation used (attempt_number + 1) instead of (attempt_number - 1), causing a first-try win to score 80 points instead of 100. Additionally, an attempt_number parity check caused 'Too High' outcomes on even attempts to add 5 points to the score instead of subtracting 5 points.
changes: Corrected win bonus calculation formula in update_score to use 100 - 10 * (attempt_number - 1).
Removed parity check in update_score so both 'Too High' and 'Too Low' outcomes deduct 5 points regardless of attempt number.
